summary: Iteration 27 — verified wallet top-up, saved card, auto-charge order, fee waiver, ratings and the iter25 regression. New pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_iteration27_wallet.py (17 tests, 6 classes, ALL PASS) plus the rewritten /app/backend/tests/test_iteration25_hangouts.py (22 tests, ALL PASS after setting hangout_free_requests=0 in its fixture so the fee-first assertions keep firing). Total 39/39 green. Front-end spot-check on desktop (aarav.mehta member and admin@buddilio.com): all 15 testids on /wallet render, quick top-up 500 lands on /checkout?kind=wallet&id=..., wallet-link visible on /hangouts/bookings, request-fee-input, free-requests-input, request-fee-save persist both settings, and ScrollToTop confirmed (scrollY 271→0 on nav link click). One real user-facing bug found and fixed here: the default nav.member returned by /api/site-content did not include the Wallet entry so no member could reach the wallet from the top bar — the review request explicitly requires 'Wallet appears in the member navbar'. Fixed by adding the Wallet link to DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT in backend/server.py (line ~4937). Companion-ratings list is empty-only-hidden — component only mounts <ul data-testid="companion-ratings"> if there is at least one rating, so a brand-new instance shows nothing. Minor design nit, not a bug. All artefacts cleaned: Tara/Aarav credits+orders+topups+saved cards purged, Ananya companion reset (completed/rating/rating_count all 0, enabled=true, status=approved), settings.hangout_request_fee=100, settings.hangout_free_requests=3, all iter25/iter27/wallet_smoke memberships removed.

ui_bugs.issue: Default nav.member returned by GET /api/site-content did not include the /wallet link, so signed-in members had no Wallet button in the top bar even though NAV_USER in Layout.jsx has one — the client always prefers site.nav.member over the local fallback. Fixed by appending {label:'Wallet', to:'/wallet'} to DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT.nav.member in backend/server.py.

issues: companion-ratings <ul> only renders when ratings.length>0 (Companions.jsx line 175). A fresh instance/no-ratings environment shows nothing under the tab, so reviewers may think the list is missing. Consider rendering an empty-state row with the same data-testid, or always render the wrapper.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: render the /wallet Wallet nav link based on user role via NAV_USER in the client only (not through site-content) so future default changes don't need a backend edit. Optional: always render <ul data-testid="companion-ratings"> with an empty-state so QA can locate the section even before any rating exists.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:5622 fulfil_topup() — idempotent via `status=='paid'` check; a replay of /api/payments/verify on a completed wallet order correctly does NOT double-credit (verified by test_topup_cannot_fulfil_twice).

backend/server.py:5711 try_auto_debit() — still bumps paid_total by the agreed amount when it debits the wallet, so paid_total mixes real gateway captures and wallet spend. Not a correctness bug for the current flows (no cash refund on companion orders) but the field is now overloaded — consider a separate wallet_spent field so finance can reconcile easily.
backend/server.py:5631 save_card() — stores brand/last4/name/exp; verified DB doc contains no 'number' or 'pan' key and no substring of the full PAN (test_put_stores_no_pan).
backend/server.py:5652 charge_saved_card() — no autopay-off short-circuit reused card; both codepaths handled (autopay=false stays payment_due, verified in test_autopay_false_skipped).

backend/server.py:5581 free_requests_left() — counts documents by fee_waived=true in the current calendar month. When quota is lowered from 3 to 0 mid-month the counted-vs-quota subtraction still returns 0 via max(...) — safe.
backend/server.py:4933 DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT — nav.member was missing the Wallet entry (fixed here). Suggest a small unit test that exercises 'critical routes appear in the default member nav'.
frontend/Companions.jsx:175 — the private ratings list is conditionally rendered; better to always mount the wrapper with an empty-state to keep testids stable.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration25_hangouts.py (fixture now sets hangout_free_requests=0 during the run and restores to 3 on teardown, so fee-first assertions still fire alongside the new waiver feature)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the review-request testids present; wallet top-up flow lands on /checkout?kind=wallet&id=...; ScrollToTop confirmed
